title: xeraea phagnaloides
intro: Xeraea phagnaloides, commonly known as Queñua, is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds and infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress, making it a potential treatment option for conditions like arthritis and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of Queñua include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
